'''Hadiss the Vaulted''' was the [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] before [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]].

==Biography==
Hadiss became the leader of the [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. A veteran of the physical and mental battles forced upon the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] during their evolution, Hadiss the Vaulted preferred to solve issues in battle. Rather than simply allowing criminals and undesirables to survive in the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] [[Petranaki arena|arenas]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Hadiss ensured that any individual who survived the necessary trials faced an enraged [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|59|A Cast of Thousands: The Making of The New Essential Guide to Star Wars Characters|A Cast of Thousands: The Making of The New Essential Guide to ''Star Wars'' Characters}}</ref>

[[File:Poggle_the_lesser_-_sw_card_trader.png|thumb|142px|Poggle the Lesser, the successor of Hadiss the Vaulted]]
His leadership skills were questioned by a small minority, led by [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], during the years prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After Poggle managed to win his way out of the gladiator arena, Poggle led an insurrection against Hadiss for several years, but Hadiss was relatively unconcerned. Then Poggle met [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], and received renewed [[Currency/Legends|finances]] and weapons. In a twist of fate, Poggle attacked Hadiss while riding on the back of an acklay, which cut Hadiss into three pieces before devouring him.<ref name="Insider" /> It was believed that part of his corpse made its way into [[Staff of Command/Legends|Poggle's cane]].
